title: Setting up App Key Vaults for Business Central on-premises

facts.text: Azure subscription with Active Directory tenant required to set up key vaults for Business Central on-premises.
Security certificate required for registering application in Microsoft Entra ID; self-signed certificate acceptable for test environments.
Create one or more Azure Key Vaults and add secrets using Azure portal, Azure CLI, or other methods; extension can use one or two vaults.
Register Microsoft Entra application for reading key vault secrets with certificate and specify Accounts in this organizational directory only.
Grant key vault reader application permission to read secrets by adding Get secret permission or assigning Key Vault Secrets User role.
Configure Server instance with certificate store location, name, thumbprint, client ID, and publisher validation setting for key vault access.
Enable Publisher Validation to block extensions from reading secrets from other publishers' key vaults; extensions need tenant ID from Publish-NAVApp.
Service account running Server instance must have permission to access certificate private key for successful key vault authentication.
